tagline: Bikes that get ridden, not admired.
one_liner: A two-bench railway-arch workshop that services, rebuilds and wheel-builds the bikes people commute on year-round.

positioning.who_its_for: Year-round commuters and audax riders who put real mileage on one bike.
positioning.what_problem: Chain shops book three weeks out and hand the bike back with the same worn drivetrain still on it.
positioning.why_them: Two mechanics, one bench each, and every job quoted in writing before a spanner touches anything.

products.name: Winter Service Plan
products.description: A quarterly strip-down through the salt season: drivetrain cleaned and measured, cables replaced, brakes bled, bearings checked.
features: Chain wear measured and reported each visit

products.name: Hand-Built Wheelset
products.description: A pair of wheels laced and tensioned by hand on our own bench, built to the rider's weight and the roads they ride.
features: Rim and hub chosen with the rider
Tension chart supplied with the build
One free re-true after the first month
